channel.title: EVENTFAQS Media Pvt - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Raffles Udaipur Appoints Gurnoor Bindra as General Manager
item.description: Raffles Udaipur has appointed Gurnoor Bindra as General Manager, bringing 16+ years of global luxury hospitality experience.

item.title: Servd Food Festival to Debut in Mumbai from February 6–8 at Jio World Garden
item.description: Mumbai will host the Servd Food Festival from February 6–8 at Jio World Garden, featuring 25+ restaurants, immersive food experiences, and live entertainment.

item.title: Seagram’s Royal Stag BoomBox Returns with Season 4, Expands to Four Cities
item.description: Seagram’s Royal Stag BoomBox is back with Season 4, touring Kolkata, Vizag, Mumbai and Mohali in early 2026 with a power-packed line-up and immersive music-led experiences.

item.title: V V. Exports Presents ‘Echoes of Bombay – One Stitch at a Time’ at 47-A, Girgaum
item.description: An embroidered art show by Kailash Poojary exploring Mumbai’s architectural legacy will be on view at 47-A, Khotachi Wadi, from February 13 to March 15.

item.title: SOCIAL Launches ‘The Pincode Party’, A Hyperlocal Cultural IP Celebrating Neighbourhood Life
item.description: SOCIAL has launched The Pincode Party, a hyperlocal cultural IP celebrating neighbourhood life, with its first edition held at Versova SOCIAL.

item.title: Royal Canin Advances Veterinary Nutrition Standards with Paediatric Program at IVCEM 2026, Mumbai
item.description: Royal Canin showcased its Paediatric Program and new veterinary diets at IVCEM 2026 in Mumbai, reinforcing its focus on early-life nutrition and preventive pet healthcare.

item.title: MAMI Mumbai Film Festival Launches ‘MAMI Independent’ with New Brand Identity
item.description: MAMI Mumbai Film Festival has launched MAMI Independent, a year-round platform for Indian independent cinema, alongside a new brand identity.

item.title: Megastar Aamir Khan to Play Pickleball with Fans and Emerging Talent in WPBL Pickler Contest
item.description: The World Pickleball League has announced the Pickler Contest, giving Mumbai-based pickleball players a chance to play alongside Aamir Khan at Jio World Garden on February 7, 2026.

item.title: Skål International India Announces Dates for Skål India National Congress 2026 in Coimbatore
item.description: Skål International India has announced the Skål India National Congress 2026, scheduled from August 12–14 at Le Méridien Coimbatore, bringing together tourism leaders from across India.

item.title: Samit Garg on Union Budget 2026–27: When India Finally Began Counting Creativity
item.description: Samit Garg talks about how the Union Budget 2026–27 formally acknowledges India’s creative and live experience economy as a measurable growth sector.
